_note: Version label of each model file the app infers with. Edit by hand when you replace a model (see .agents/architecture.md, 'Model versions'). The System log page (/system) shows these next to the file's date and fingerprint, and logs every change it detects.

face_recognition.note: Triplet + cosine (verification_fp32_v1/selected_model.pt), threshold 0.5254 in the checkpoint

anti_spoofing.note: anti_spoofing_v2 (v1 fine-tuned on team photos incl. phone-screen spoofs, finetune_team.py), threshold 0.4 in the checkpoint

live_face_scan.note: 06_backbones.ipynb winner: MobileNetV3-Small, Kaggle (stage A) then team photos + recorded-video faces (stage B); labels from face_recognition v1 (pinned); threshold 0.58 in the checkpoint (webcam domain)

glasses_detection.note: MobileNetV3-Small, 112 px, threshold 0.0048 in the checkpoint (val AUC 0.992)

emotion.note: ResNet-18 on FER2013 + AffectNet, FER2013 test acc 0.707
